news.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
news.summary: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

news.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
news.summary: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

news.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
news.summary: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.
